context: Verification rubric: no sf1000 run exists without its benchmark's sf100 pilot evidence and a reserve-affordability check in the item context. Excluded by default at large scale: havoc/skew/obt, datavault, clickbench, amplab, h2odb, coffeeshop, joinorder, tsbs, nyctaxi, flightdata.
description: Stage 5. Starts only after stage4 resolves (complete or cut) and only from the Gate 0 reserve. Single pilot first: tpch sf100 untuned (observe load time, storage, credits). Expand on pilot evidence: same-benchmark tuned/untuned, then next benchmark in Tier order (tpcds, tpcdi, ssb, then primitives). sf1000 admitted per benchmark only after its sf100 stayed in budget. Primitives above sf10 require a dry-run row estimate first: read primitives scale as ~6M x SF rows on the lineitem base (benchbox/core/read_primitives/benchmark.py:296), so sf100 ~= 600M rows and sf1000 ~= 6B rows — treat primitives-sf1000 as guilty until proven innocent. Seeds: use --official --seed 42 only for tpch/tpcds official scales; otherwise match baseline (no seed). Decision gate: pilot go/no-go per benchmark; sf1000 per-benchmark admission. Guardrails: reserve-only spend; reload-vs-reuse from Gate 2 still applies (large-scale loads dominate cost); same publish/provenance/drop rules as stage4; trial-expiry buffer kept (no new large loads in the final window).
